# SQLite migration fixtures

These are real SQLite files used by `tests/test_persistence_migrations.py`.
Each file has both `schema_metadata.schema_version` and SQLite
`PRAGMA user_version` set to its fixture version.

- `v1.sqlite3`: generated from the v1 store at commit
  `9045191f2a44b05869d10d2038ab54fabe61b75c`.
- `v2.sqlite3`: generated from the v2 store at commit
  `2f05f50a9bf2c52abfc26e4c29b7e64ed8d7121b`.
- `v3.sqlite3` and `v4.sqlite3`: v4-compatible SQLite layout from the alpha
  candidate commit `df40a9683004ab58fb38497d1aecfc8f1fffa288`, tagged with the
  supported v3 and v4 metadata values. The repository history has no separate
  v3 DDL snapshot; these fixtures test version acceptance and staged upgrade,
  not a claim about an absent historical DDL.
- `v5.sqlite3`: generated by the current schema and includes
  `runtime_provenance`.

The fixtures contain no credentials, model output, or data-root state. A
version below 5 must pass preflight and upgrade atomically to v5 on a copy;
the source fixture is never modified by the test.
